description: This file defines a common interface for message passing in the process sandboxer component of the Cuttlefish project, including a Message class and related constants and functions for socket communication.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents a message in the sandboxer communication, capable of receiving data from a socket, retrieving data and credentials, and error reporting.

methods.name: RecvFrom
methods.description: Receives a Message from the specified socket.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns the message data as a string.

methods.name: DataAsInt
methods.description: Interprets the message data as an integer.

methods.name: Credentials
methods.description: Returns the optional credentials associated with the message.

methods.name: StrError
methods.description: Returns a string describing the last error.
